_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in euros. The debt component, history and facts are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_eurostat.py from Eurostat tables gov_10q_ggdebt and demo_pjan; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Luxembourg
title: Luxembourg National Debt Clock: Live Debt, Official Data
headline: general government debt
subject: The general government of Luxembourg
sum_note: Luxembourg general government gross debt (Maastricht definition, quarter-end), from Eurostat's quarterly government debt statistics, which are compiled from national data.
scope_note: This is general government gross debt in the EU Maastricht (excessive deficit procedure) definition, from Eurostat's quarterly table: currency and deposits, debt securities and loans of central government, local government and social security funds, at nominal value, consolidated. Figures are in euros. Central government is shown below as a fact and is not added on top.
trend_why: We use the latest four quarters rather than the last quarter because quarter-to-quarter changes swing with bond issuance calendars and short-term borrowing.
legend: Luxembourg's government debt is reported quarterly, at quarter-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official quarter-end figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Quarterly. Eurostat publishes each quarter-end figure (table gov_10q_ggdebt) about three months after the quarter ends.
after_text: , about three months after each quarter-end
next_update: The Q3 2026 quarter-end figure is expected from Eurostat roughly three months after the quarter ends; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

facts.label: Luxembourg central government gross debt (Maastricht)
facts.note: Central government (Eurostat sector S.1311) in the same table, on the same Maastricht definition. It is not added to the headline. A year earlier (2025-06-30) it was €20.1 billion. Central government is 93.5% of the general government total.

extra_sources.name: Eurostat, Government finance statistics - quarterly data

notes: Why Eurostat: it publishes quarterly government debt for EU and EFTA countries on one Maastricht definition, compiled from the figures national statistical institutes and central banks report. The fetcher reads the public API directly.
What this page counts: general government gross debt (sector S.13), not central government alone. The central government figure is a fact and is not added again.
Provisional data: Eurostat flags the latest quarters as provisional and revises them. The page re-bases to each new release.
Source tier: harmonized official dataset (Eurostat gov_10q_ggdebt). As-of date is the quarter-end of the latest published stock.
Cross-check: STATEC publishes the government finance figures that feed the Eurostat table.
